description: This file provides multilingual support functions, including loading language JSON files via AJAX, normalizing language codes, and auto-adapting UI elements with translated content. It defines functions for dynamic language switching and manages language data objects.

methods.name: load_lang_lib
methods.description: Loads language JSON file via AJAX, extends language object, and applies translations to UI elements.

methods.name: normaliseLang
methods.description: Converts language code to standardized format aa-AA.

methods.name: autoAdapt_i18n
methods.description: Automatically updates UI elements with translations based on language object.

methods.name: autoAdapt_obj_i18n
methods.description: Applies translations to a specific target object.
